sandboxState.authority: docs/domain/systems-of-record.md §3.3. The row list, entity strings and store citations here are recomputed from that table by tests/unit/systems-of-record.test.ts — this block cannot claim a family the document does not, or drop one it does.
sandboxState.meaning: sandbox-state: at least one store the served screen reads is process memory (systems-of-record.md §3.3), so what the operator creates here is lost when the process exits. It is not a claim that the screen is fake or its logic untested — it is the Rule 0.4a label that says persistence must not be inferred from a screen working.
sandboxState.derivation: An entry carries dataState=sandbox-state if and only if its own `evidence` names one of a family's anchors (a store file path, a `file.ts:NN` citation, or the engine/symbol that owns the store). tests/unit/systems-of-record.test.ts recomputes that set from this file, compares both directions, and resolves every anchor against the repository — an unlabelled screen that cites a sandbox store fails the suite exactly like a labelled screen whose anchor has stopped existing.

sandboxState.limits: The label set is anchored to evidence text, so a screen whose evidence names only a renderer cannot be labelled by this rule; its data state must be traced by hand. Traced by hand on 2026-10-13 and deliberately NOT labelled: UX-BR-012 renders channel/episode-master state plus fixed blocker copy and reads none of these stores; UX-SYS-013 keeps its session registry in Postgres (TSK-17 §3.1), where only the preferences/first-use/inbox side stores are sandbox-state. Families with no labelled screen as at 2026-10-13: proof-of-air-registry, bank-reconciliation, broadcast-traffic, playout-cache. That is a labelling residual, not a clean bill of health: each of these still holds the only copy of its entities exactly as §3.3 says, and the register simply has no screen whose evidence names it — the proof-of-air registry and the traffic make-good queue are reached through engines and fixtures, the reconciliation engine has no register screen at all, and the playout cache backs panels the served census already records as NOT_CONNECTED (TSK-25). Served-level honesty stays on the provenance banner, which is a different instrument.
